I already want to go back
Jul 2023 • Friends
Exquisite. Everything about this restaurant is to love. Location: tucked away in an alley, it loses the noise of the streets while maintaining a bright atmosphere with various little bars tucked into the nooks and crannies of the alley. So close to the river as well! The waitress who runs the restaurant is so nice, and the restaurant itself is neatly decorated, somewhat resembling Greek architecture! But the most important thing, the food, is what separates Kebaby the rest. Unbelievably delicious kebabs, overly generous sizes, and all for a great price! Good lamb is hard to come by in Vietnam, but this place delivers. Chips hit the spot as well. As a casual dinner with family or friends, this is the place to go.

I was "Wowed" by the Kebaby Roll
Jan 2021
It was my first time eating at Kebaby…

 I wasn’t expecting to be “wowed” when I ordered a Mixed Chicken/Lamb Kebab Roll on Naan Bread. The massive roll arrived on a wooden board, rustically, yet carefully wrapped with brown paper and twine. Starkly contrasted by the aesthetically pleasing brown wrapping and wooden board was a white, pillowy and satisfyingly chewy Naan Bread, which blanketed colorful and carefully crafted ingredients that made up the dazzlingly delicious inside of the roll. 

There was a lot going on, but in a good way. Each bite tasted unique. Each bite had a balance of richness and fattiness from the meats with crunchiness and freshness from the vegetables. The sauces took things to the next level. I soon realized I was physically unable to put the roll down until I devoured all of its delectable contents. I was very much in the zone and it was an overall pleasant experience.

Shout out to Joe who was kind enough to provide tons of background information about his journey to becoming a kebab connoisseur. His passion for his product really made the experience more special.

It won’t be my last time eating at Kebaby…
